issues.detail: Connected GitHub app authentication and public repo metadata read PASS; no accessible dedicated commissioning repo found. CLI remains unauthenticated. Repo creation and push need new authorization. No token copied between systems.
No native UI surfaces exposed. Bionic native projects, approval behavior and independent native version remain unverified; API/MCP acceptance passes.
ShellCheck, clang analysis, Java lint/JUnit, Rust clippy, ruff, limited mypy, SBOM and dependency audits pass. Secret scan remains heuristic; GPU vendor advisory coverage limited.
One unexplained Python 3.14 streaming failure; control and Python 3.12 tests pass. Forensic verification pinned to Python 3.12. Root cause undetermined; failed evidence preserved.
